subdivision_of_building: The proposals only affect the upper storeys 1st Floor - Roof.
description: Erection of a roof extension with sedum roof and rooflights to the front elevation, erection of a two-storey rear extension at first-floor level and replacement of windows to the rear elevation all associated with 1 x new Bedsit.

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: The building is existing and there is no existing provision for external waste storage.

decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed first and second floor rear extensions, by reason of their height, bulk, scale and detailed design, would form an incongruous and visually intrusive addition which fails to respect the established form, proportions and architectural character of the building causing harm to the special architectural or historic significance of the listed building and the character and appearance of the Seven Dials Conservation Area contrary to Policies D1 (Design) and D2 (Heritage) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Reason : 2 - The proposed roof extension, by reason of its height, siting and design, would fail to appear as a subordinate addition and disrupt a largely unaltered and consistent roofscape, it would be visually intrusive and harm the architectural composition of the building, causing harm to the special architectural or historic significance of the listed building and the character and appearance of the Seven Dials Conservation Area contrary to Policies D1 (Design) and D2 (Heritage) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Reason : 3 - In the absence of sufficient information in the form of a detailed Daylight and Sunlight Assessment and contextual elevation plans, the proposal fails to demonstrate that the development would not result in an unacceptable loss of light to the neighbouring properties of Nos. 57 Endell Street and 61A Endell Street contrary to Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Reason : 4 - In the absence of adequate information, including a detailed Daylight and Sunlight Assessment and contextual elevation plans, the application fails to demonstrate that the development would not result in an unacceptable loss of natural light, increased sense of enclosure or loss of outlook for the rear units at Nos.?1-5 Ventana Court. The proposal therefore conflicts with Policy A1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Reason : 5 - In the absence of a completed legal agreement securing the development as car free, the proposed one bedroom (second floor) flat and the two bedroom residential maisonette would be likely to generate additional on street parking demand. This would result in increased parking stress and congestion within the surrounding area, to the detriment of highway safety and residential amenity. The proposal therefore fails to promote sustainable modes of transport and does not adequately manage the impacts of development. As such, the development is contrary to Policies T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport), T2 (Parking and car parking), A1 (Managing the impact of development) and DM1 (Delivery and monitoring) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Reason : 6 - In the absence of a completed legal agreement securing the proposed development fails to make adequate provision for off street cycle parking to serve the residential units. In the absence of any clearly identified compliant cycle storage facilities, the proposal does not encourage sustainable modes of transport and would place undue reliance on less sustainable travel choices. The development is therefore contrary to Policy T1 (Prioritising walking, cycling and public transport) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.

Reason : 7 - In the absence of a completed legal agreement to secure a Construction Management Plan, together with the associated implementation support contribution and impact bond, the proposed development fails to adequately demonstrate that construction related impacts can be satisfactorily managed. As a result, the development would be likely to cause undue harm to the amenity of neighbouring occupiers through noise, disturbance and disruption during the construction phase. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy A1 (Managing the impact of development) of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
